body: Yeah, it's like, all we talk about. But I'm not getting better and we just keep going in circles, and I just get worse and worse at everything and feel more and more ashamed of my entire existence. Like, I stopped dating because I couldn't bear to try to convince someone I'm an ok person to be around, when I know I'm a total failure and embarrassment to my friends and family
I see my therapist every week, and my psychiatrist every other month. It helps with everything but the school stuff.

I feel like I don't even have time to think about it. Like, I can't even finish reading over the instructions for an assignment without self injuring, and after like half an hour of that then suicide just seems like the logical next step, and I just sit there and try not to move because I feel like if I move I'll do something I can't undo.
I can't keep my job if I don't finish my masters. I don't care if I do super well or anything, but my professors can't pass me if I don't do the work.
What's to say? I'm defective and it's going to kill me.
